The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow. Meet Nuvei , Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere.

Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services.

Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei , we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission As a Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for developing a sales pipeline of Mid-Market merchants and drive revenue across North America. Key Responsibilities Follow a disciplined approach to forecasting and opportunity management via SFDC and our supporting tools and processes.

Understand the prospects business and global payments footprint, their strategic growth plans, and competitive landscape. Present technical products and innovative solutions to prospects at C-level. Introduce Nuvei ’s technical, operational, and strategic resources at the appropriate stages of the sales cycle to move opportunities forward.

Negotiate contracts in a complex selling environment between various stakeholders. (business, legal, procurement, finance, etc.) Requirements Experience working on high performance commercial teams. 5 years of experience in global payments industry. Pipeline management and forecasting expertise. Ability to travel to events and prospect meetings.

Financial modeling and contract negotiation experience. Exceptional relationship-building skills. Experience working with global cross function team stakeholders. Fluent in English.

Benefits Competitive holiday allowance 401K Matching program Group Insurance Benefits Flexible working model Employee Assistance Program Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace.

The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

Working Language English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed. We are seeking a Channel Sales Manager to grow and enhance our channel sales initiatives, who will help us with building strong partnerships and with driving revenue through distributor and partner networks.

The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in managing channel relationships, nurturing sales pipelines, and exceeding sales targets through indirect sales channels, bringing both strategic vision and hands-on execution skills within the SaaS industry.

In this role, you will also engage directly with customers and potential customers to understand their needs, nurture relationships and close deals. What You’ll Do: Partner Development & Management: Establish and nurture relationships with distributors and channel partners across Southern Europe to expand IceWarp’s market presence.

Channel Strategy Execution: Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic channel plans aimed at driving significant revenue growth. Pipeline Growth: Actively engage with partners to identify opportunities, provide support, and facilitate deals through the sales cycle using CRM (SFDC).

Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to align strategies, messaging and ensure seamless onboarding and support for channel-generated customers. Sales Enablement: Train and empower partners with the knowledge and resources needed to effectively promote and sell IceWarp solutions.

Reporting & Analytics: Regularly monitor, analyze, and report channel sales performance metrics to refine strategies and maximize sales effectiveness. Market Insight: Continuously gather feedback from partners and end-users to enhance our offerings and address market demands effectively.

Partner/Distributor Impact: Listen & Respond: Use feedback from partners and customers to identify and overcome obstacles, ensuring their success. Engage & Support: Promote partner events, encourage participation in surveys, and connect resources to keep the sales pipeline flowing smoothly.

What we offer: Collaboration with a European company whose product is used by over 50 million users worldwide, competing with Google and Microsoft.

The opportunity to come up with new ideas and implement them immediately Long-term cooperation The chance to expand knowledge in various interesting areas 25 days of paid leave 5 Personal days Requirements What We’re Looking For: Experience: At least 3 years of experience in SaaS Channel Sales with a focus on the Italian/Spanish market.

We expect you will know the local partners. Language skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken. Autonomy: Ability to work independently while still collaborating effectively with the internal sales team. Travel-Ready: Willingness to travel as needed. Cloud Savvy: A solid understanding of cloud concepts.

Who is Eleos Health ?
Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human. Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do .
What is the opportunity: We’re hiring an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with our existing customers as we scale our digital health SaaS platform.

This role blends account management and consultative sales, giving you the opportunity to deepen customer partnerships while driving revenue growth by selling new products, features, and expansions.

You’ll work closely with healthcare stakeholders and internal teams to help customers achieve meaningful outcomes while expanding their use of our platform. Who you are: You are a relationship-first, growth-minded professional who enjoys working with existing customers and identifying ways to deliver more value.

You’re comfortable having strategic conversations with clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders and know how to balance trust-building with revenue responsibility. You thrive in fast-paced startup environments, take ownership of your work, and are motivated by both customer success and business impact. How will you contribute:
Manage and grow a book with significant ARR expansion responsibility
Collaborate with internal teams including Product, CS Ops, Support, and Implementation to resolve issues and deliver improvements
Drive customer retention, adoption, and long-term account health
Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning clinical, operational, and RCM/billing audiences.
Sell new products, modules, and features aligned to customer needs and outcomes
Manage expansion opportunities through the full sales cycle and meet or exceed growth targets
Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and expansion quota ownership
Own renewals end-to-end, including contract discussions and pricing conversations
Develop account plans aligned to customer goals and Eleos growth objectives

We are hiring on behalf of our client who is building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of global payments. Cross-border money movement remains one of the most complex, fragmented, and underserved challenges in financial services; our client addresses this at the infrastructure level for FinTech's, payment service providers (PSPs), and financial institutions powering global commerce.
The organization is seeking a senior, high-autonomy Enterprise Account Executive to drive sales of cross-border payments and banking infrastructure solutions to global fintechs and enterprise technology companies within the United States. This individual will own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through solution design, closing, and implementation—working closely with internal teams to deliver payment infrastructure that is both technically sound and commercially compelling.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in the US payments and fintech space, an established professional network, and the technical grounding to lead product conversations regarding architecture and integrations without requiring constant engineering support.

Full-Cycle Sales Ownership: Lead deals from prospecting and qualification through commercial negotiation, closing, and post-sale implementation planning.
Pipeline Generation: Leverage an existing network within the US fintech and payments ecosystem to generate and manage a robust book of business.
Technical Discovery: Engage prospects at an architectural level regarding payment rails, integration models, compliance frameworks, and treasury operations.
Solution Design: Collaborate with internal architects, compliance, and product teams to develop client-specific proposals that are technically feasible and regulatorily sound.
Commercial Negotiation: Structure pricing, contracts, and partnership terms that align with both client objectives and the organization’s business framework.
Pre-Sales Execution: Develop compelling proposals and pitch materials for a range of buyer personas, including engineering leaders, CFOs, and C-suite executives.
Implementation Support: Coordinate with onboarding teams post-close to ensure a smooth transition and successful client go-live.
Market Representation: Participate in industry conferences and client meetings to enhance the client's visibility and reputation within the ecosystem.

Professional Experience: 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience specifically within payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure.
Proven Track Record: A demonstrable history of hitting and exceeding quotas on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
Hunter Mentality: Proactive drive to find and win new business, taking genuine ownership of pipeline generation.
Industry Network: A strong, active US-based network in the fintech, PSP, and payments infrastructure space to generate immediate opportunities.
Domain Expertise: Solid working knowledge of global payment rails (SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, FPS, RTP), API-driven integrations, and compliance frameworks (AML/KYC).
Operational Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by a fast-moving "builder" environment rather than managing established processes.
Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to maintain technical credibility in detailed product discussions.
Preferred Skills: Experience with stablecoins, embedded finance, or global settlement networks is highly advantageous.

High Impact: Join an organization at a critical inflection point where individual contributions are highly visible and measurable.
Ownership: Significant autonomy to drive commercial strategy and manage the full client lifecycle.
Growth Potential: Opportunity to operate within a genuinely differentiated product space that addresses a massive, underserved global market.
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a team empowered to act like founders and deliver outcomes that matter in the financial services sector.

At Simon, we firmly believe business success starts and ends with people. We’re scrappy problem solvers who care deeply about tackling big challenges with disruptive thinking, giving our customers the support they need, and investing in each other’s growth. We all do our best work when we’re surrounded by other friendly top performers who want to succeed together. When you trust your team, give them ownership, and build with heart, great things happen.
Simon Data was founded in 2015 by a team of successful serial entrepreneurs. Today, we’re more than a CDP—Simon is a complete solution that empowers marketers with the data, technology, and expert resources they need to stop guessing and start delivering what customers want.
Our revolutionary Simon AI puts 100x more data at marketers’ fingertips, helping them uncover their best audiences, launch higher-performing campaigns, and double their output without doubling the workload. That’s why leading brands like ASOS, Mattress Firm, and 1-800-Flowers trust Simon to power sustainable, high-performing customer marketing programs.

The marketing status quo isn’t cutting it anymore. Today’s teams need more than dashboards and guesswork — they need real outcomes. Simon Data delivers the industry’s first goal-based AI marketing workflow, translating business objectives directly into high-performing audience segments. Unlike generic AI solutions, our Agents work with your existing data today to deliver real results—no black box, no fluff.
We’re scaling fast and rewriting how modern SaaS sales should feel. As an Account Executive at Simon, you won’t just sell — you’ll help define how our product gets positioned, how our pipeline gets built, and how our deals get won.

Own the deal. Drive the full sales cycle from outbound to close — and do it with precision, urgency, and heart.
Sell to the C-suite. Build trust with Marketing, Data, and Tech leaders at high-growth brands and enterprise players alike.
Make the complex simple. Run clear, value-driven demos and proofs of concept that tie customer goals to Simon’s outcomes.
Collaborate like it’s your job (because it is). Work closely with Marketing, Product, and CS to turn insights into action — and wins.
Stay sharp. Be a voice of the market, bringing back what you hear to shape messaging, features, and strategy.
Hustle smart. Use Gong, Outreach, Salesforce, and whatever else helps you keep deals moving and priorities focused.

B2B SaaS closer with a track record. You’ve owned and crushed quota, ideally in MarTech, CDP, or data-first SaaS.
Consultative seller. You know how to listen, strategize, and tie product features to big-picture business goals.
Builder mindset. You love a fast-paced environment where you can shape process, not just follow one.
Confident communicator. Whether you’re pitching the CMO or collaborating with an internal stakeholder, you bring clarity and confidence.
Curious and coachable. You’re always looking to grow, and you’re open to feedback and iteration.
Tool-savvy. You know your way around Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Slack, and whatever else gets the job done.
Self-starter with urgency. You don’t wait to be told what to do — you move, you learn, and you make things happen

You’ll sell a product you believe in. Our AI delivers real results, fast — and customers love it.
You’ll join a team that’s scaling smart. High trust, low ego, and serious about winning together .
You’ll grow fast. Personally, professionally, and in your career — with support, feedback, and a path forward.
You’ll help shape a category. We’re not just selling software. We’re building the next generation of customer intelligence.
You’ll work with people who care. About the work. About the mission. About each other.

We take care of our team — because when you’re supported, you show up stronger. Here’s a taste of what you can expect:
Full health coverage, zero stress. We cover 100% of medical premiums for you and your family.
️ Truly flexible PTO. Take the time you need to recharge, travel, or just log off. No judgment, no red tape.
Generous parental leave. Whether you’re growing your family or just need time to adjust, we’ve got you covered — with both maternity and paternity leave that respects your life outside of work.
Remote-first perks. Work from anywhere, with quarterly wellness and client support stipends to keep you feeling balanced and equipped.
Growth on your terms. Use your annual professional development stipend to level up, learn something new, or invest in the next step of your journey.

We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer.

As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients.

What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding.

We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make a difference for patients.

We work to remove ambiguity from patient care in a space where every decision matters, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.
As an Oncology Account Manager, your primary responsibility will be selling GE HealthCare’s PET Imaging Agent (Cerianna). This is a wing-to-wing, multi-faceted Account Manager role that has multiple call points and strategic priorities.

Call points will primarily focus on PET Imaging Centers, PET technologists, Radiology Management, Radiologists, and Supply Chain.

In addition, the role will help support driving demand and call on Medical Oncologists and Breast Surgeons to provide information and education on Cerianna, reimbursement resources, etc. to drive demand for the product into Imaging Centers.

Third, a critical call point are pharmacy partners who manufacture the product and in-field collaboration to drive new business.
Job Description

Developing and executing on a multi-faceted territory plan that includes partnering with hospitals / imaging centers to offer imaging services to utilize Cerianna.
Position Cerianna as a molecular imaging diagnostic PET agent for recurrent or metastatic ER+ breast cancer and properly position in the breast cancer patient care pathway.
Identify the top referring health care providers, foster relationships, and appropriately impact the decision-making criteria to help increase awareness about Cerianna.
Be a trusted advisor to imaging centers and referrers to help unlock opportunities to access Cerianna and remove barriers to ordering Cerianna.
Collaborate with reimbursement market access support teams to optimize payor contract implementation and satisfaction across imaging centers and hospitals.
Collaborate with pharmacy channel partners to meet the customer’s product delivery goals and expectations.
Pre-call planning and in-call questioning to understand customer needs, craft solutions and drive utilization.
Monitor territory plan performance and results, collaborate on next action steps with cross-functional partners.
Virtual selling and cold calling to new and existing targets.
Providing pricing strategy, price negotiation and contract management, and ensuring pricing compliance for segment opportunities.
Forecasting orders and sales of assigned territory and submit weekly progress reports.
Representing the company at healthcare conferences and seminars to promote our products and company.
Have a deep understanding of the Imaging Center / Hospital department goals, needs, workflow, financial expectations, etc. around PET imaging.
Coordinate with the Strategic Account Managers on broader health care system strategies to drive demand and remove barriers to access Cerianna.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college or valid and current certification through the NMTCB or AART
3+ years sales experience or relevant experience in a medical, healthcare, technical, pharmaceutical or Life Sciences field
Experience selling into hospitals, contracting, and supply chain or relevant clinical experience in a healthcare setting
Proven track record of sales success, developing, organizing and implementing sales plans, meeting and exceeding sales targets, and penetrating new accounts/markets/competitive through proficiency in prospecting, lead qualification, sales and negotiations or relevant experience in a healthcare organization leading successful adoption of new ideas, programs, or initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to achieve objectives while operating in compliance with regulatory guidelines
Demonstrated communication skills, analytical skills and Nuclear Medicine/PET/pharmaceutical industry acumen
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities through effective organizational, people, and time management skills

Must be willing and able to do 50% overnight travel.

Who Are We?
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via -----
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
The Opportunity.
Each SMB Account Executive has a set territory of accounts (up to 1,000 employees) across the DACH region, containing existing Postman users on all levels of Postman.

The goal is to build strategies to manage target accounts while working new inbound leads, with the intention of understanding how they are using Postman, and introduce them to all the capabilities of our Enterprise Suite.

This is a unique opportunity to join the rapidly growing sales team at Postman and we are looking for passionate, energetic people to further scale our fast-growing business. The ideal candidate has personally driven significant sales growth at Technical SaaS companies.

Given a portfolio or group of organizations with the most promising growth opportunities, build a credible funnel for Postman Enterprise adoption
Take ownership of the full sales cycle from lead to close
Build a strategic outbound motion for your territory
Convert inbound leads to closed opportunities
Execute a land and expand sales strategy to drive widespread adoption and larger deployments
Help educate customers on the value of Postman throughout the evaluation and adoption cycle
Navigate key decision makers to build Postman Enterprise awareness within organizations
Leverage data to understand your customers and prospects to gain insight into their business challenges
Be a great listener, identify customer needs and collaborate with Postman teammates to ensure customer success

Provide a detailed, accurate forecast
Collaborate and work with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success Managers, Account Development representatives Leadership, etc. to build strategic adoption plans for customers in large accounts
Provide recommendations based on customers’ business needs and usage patterns

Able to strategically map out and break into accounts
Successful track record of pipeline generation
Relevant sales experience preferably in an Enterprise SaaS organization
Experience selling developer and/or technical products a strong plus
Excellent communication skills both with customers and within an organization
Proven negotiation and closing skills, as demonstrated by regularly exceeding sales targets while selling right-fit customers.
Strong track record of navigating organizations across multiple verticals/industries
Ability to develop senior level relationships quickly and effectively
Experience presenting to senior managers and the C-suite

Teamplayer

What Else?
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend.

Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about.

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels.

For more information, please visit ASD Market Week is one of the largest and longest-running business-to-business general merchandise trade shows in the United States.

Re-engage dormant, lapsed, and previously lost exhibitors with relevant and compelling commercial proposals.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

As a Key Account Manager –you will partner with our most important customers to lead the transformation of their practices with innovative digital solutions to drive incremental sales and market share growth for Align’s orthodontic and digital solutions (including Invisalign and iTero). Your mission is to accelerate revenue, increase case volume, and deliver superior clinical outcomes and patient experiences.

Établir des relations efficaces avec les décideurs et influenceurs de haut niveau au sein des organisations clientes.
Démontrer un engagement indéfectible envers la collaboration, comme en témoigne leur partenariat étroit avec le TM assigné au compte en tant que propriétaire principal du compte.
Créer un dialogue stratégique pour positionner les solutions Align en orthodontie, en flux de travail restauratif et en numérisation intraorale.
Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec les équipes internes (marketing, service à la clientèle, logistique, commercial, développement de produits) pour répondre aux besoins des clients.

Atteindre les objectifs de ventes trimestriels et annuels pour le territoire et les comptes assignés.

Négocier avec les décideurs afin de positionner Align comme la solution complète pour les besoins en orthodontie et en numérisation numérique.

Promouvoir les valeurs ACA et encourager la collaboration entre les équipes.

Former les clients sur les produits Invisalign et iTero afin d’assurer leur confort clinique et leur adoption.
Communiquer de façon interfonctionnelle (dentiste, coordonnateur de traitement, assistant clinique, éducation, marketing) pour comprendre les besoins d’affaires et articuler l’adéquation avec les solutions Align.
Orchestrer des ressources internes supplémentaires pour optimiser l’expérience client et promouvoir les solutions Align.
Professionnalisme et agilité
Faire preuve de créativité, d’autodiscipline et être capable d’identifier et de réaliser des tâches critiques de façon autonome avec un fort sens de l’urgence.
Écouter, comprendre et analyser les besoins des clients afin d’adapter les produits et services Align pour offrir une expérience client de classe mondiale.

Strategic Relationship Building
Build effective relationships with high-level decision-makers and influencers in customer organizations.
Demonstrate an unwavering commitment to collaboration as demonstrated by their close partnership with the account’s assigned TM as the primary owner of the account.
Create strategic dialogue to position Align’s solutions for orthodontic treatment, restorative workflows, and digital intraoral scanning.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams (Marketing, Customer Service, Logistics, Commercial, Product Development) to support customer needs.
Business Planning & Execution
Translate business strategies into clear objectives and tactics; create realistic sales forecasts, budgets, and contingency plans.
Plan and execute territory and account plans based on deep understanding of each account’s business, goals, challenges, and opportunities.
Utilize data and analytics to help customers drive decision-making and optimize office processes.
Sales & Account Management
Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets for assigned territory and accounts.
Develop, communicate, and implement strategic sales plans for key accounts, leveraging insights and consultative selling approaches.
Monitor account performance, redirect efforts when goals are not met, and champion change to increase sales effectiveness.
Negotiate with decision-makers to position Align as the complete solution for orthodontic and digital scanning needs.
Leadership & Collaboration
Demonstrate sales leadership through mentorship, coaching, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Assume regional training and onboarding responsibilities as assigned by the Regional Manager.
Support regional initiatives and special projects (e.g., meetings, customer events).
Champion ACA values and foster collaboration across teams.

Educate customers on Invisalign and iTero products to ensure clinical comfort and adoption.
Communicate cross-functionally (Doctor, Treatment Coordinator, clinical assistant, education, marketing) to understand business needs and articulate the fit with Align’s solutions.
Orchestrate additional internal resources to optimize the customer experience and promote Align solutions.
Professionalism & Agility
Be creative, self-disciplined, and capable of identifying and completing critical tasks independently with a high sense of urgency.
Listen, understand, and analyze customer needs to tailor Align products and services for a best-in-class customer experience.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi 's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity.

Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.
Sobi Culture
At Sobi , we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them.

This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain.

Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Our Role
The Accelerate Account Manager owns a portfolio of around 60 customers representing roughly $2.5M in annual revenue. Your main job is keeping those customers happy, healthy, and renewing. You'll make sure they're getting real results from Ada, catch risk early, and run renewals from start to finish. You'll also carry an expansion target and will give you real experience owning a number and spotting growth opportunities, with coaching and support around you as you build those skills.
This is a scaled, high-volume role. You won't go deep on a handful of accounts. You'll learn to manage a full book: knowing where to spend your time, which accounts need attention this week, and how to keep everyone else moving forward without a lot of hand-holding.

1+ year of experience in a customer-facing or commercial role, such as Account Manager, BDR/SDR, Customer Success, or Account Executive, ideally in B2B SaaS.
You're organized and comfortable juggling a lot of accounts at once without letting things slip.
You like talking to customers and you're good at figuring out what they actually care about.
You're curious about how a business runs and want to understand the numbers behind your customers' results.
You stay calm when a customer is frustrated and you follow through on what you say you'll do.
You're coachable. You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better quickly.
You can explain what a customer needs to internal teams like Support, Product, and Solutions in a clear, simple way.
You're comfortable in tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, or MS Office, and pick up new software fast.
Bonus: you've carried a quota or target before, even a small one.
Outcomes
Retain your book. Own renewals across your portfolio and hit your retention target. Start renewal conversations early and don't let anything show up as a surprise.
Keep customers healthy. Track usage, automation rates, and account health. Spot at-risk accounts early and build a plan to turn them around.
Show customers the value they're getting. Run regular check-ins and business reviews that connect Ada to results the customer cares about, like resolved conversations, cost savings, or team capacity.
Grow where it makes sense. Find expansion opportunities inside your book, such as higher conversation volume, new channels, or new use cases, and work toward your expansion target.
Build relationships. Get to know your day-to-day contacts well and build connections with the decision-makers who own the budget and the renewal.
Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce up to date and give a clear, honest read on renewals and pipeline every week.
Know when to escalate. Recognize when an account has outgrown Accelerate or needs more senior help, and bring in the right people.
